levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Fewer than three items are checked against the guidance sheet, or the safe/needs-attention call is not based on the sheet's stated temperature or shelf-life information.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All three items are checked against the guidance sheet, and each safe/needs-attention call correctly matches the stated shelf-life or temperature information.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner identifies which item is closest to the end of its safe window and explains why.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The reheating method or target temperature/doneness sign is not named, or the adult confirmation is missing.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The correct method and target temperature or doneness sign from the guidance sheet is named and confirmed by the adult.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the reflection connects the reheating step to why undercooked leftovers specifically pose a foodborne illness risk.

lookFors: Each of the three storage decisions cites a specific detail from the guidance sheet (a temperature number or a shelf-life window), not a guess.
The reflection names a specific new habit tied to what was actually found, not a generic 'I will be more careful' statement.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
